test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 26 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who is NOT an awardee of the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mandeep Singh.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna Award**

__
 
• **Formerly known** as** the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award in Sports and Games.**
 
• The **highest sporting honour of India.**
 
• It is awarded annually by the** Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.**
 
• The award comprises a** medallion, a certificate,** and a **cash prize of ₹25 lakh** (as of 2020).
 
• Established in** 1992.**

**Mandeep Singh**

 
• **Indian professional field hockey player.**
 
• Plays as a** forward** for** Delhi Waveriders** in the** Hockey India League** and the** India men's national field hockey team.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** Manpreet Singh

 
• **Indian field hockey player** and the** captain of India men's national field hockey team** since May 2017.
 
• He led the Indian field hockey team to the **bronze medal **at the **Tokyo 2020 Olympics.**
 
• He plays as a** halfback.**
 
• In** 2021, **he was awarded by** Khel Ratna Award.**

**Sumit Antil**

 
• **Indian Paralympian and javelin thrower**.
 
• **Gold medalist **in the **2020 Summer Paralympics.**
 
• He holds the **current world record, having thrown 68.55 metres in the Paralympic final.**
 
• In 2021, he was awarded by Khel Ratna Award.

Krishna Nagar

 
• **Indian para-badminton player**.
 
• Ranked as** world number 2 in para-badminton men's Singles SH6**.
 
• He has** won a gold medal at 2020 Summer Paralympics.**
 
• In 2021, he was awarded by Khel Ratna Award.
